dedupe_keys.name: simulation and experimental data of frequency domain and time domain optical signal measurements for optical network digital twins

description: Marc Ruiz and Luis Velasco publish experimental and simulated IQ samples for 16-QAM optical connections. The README gives January–June 2023 collection coverage and describes 62 simulated lightpaths plus four progressively strengthened soft-failure cases. Experiments and MATLAB simulations use distinct optical testbed configurations. Compressed CSV data are freely available under CC BY 4.0, with a related original dataset DOI recorded as 10.34810/data1143. The collection can calibrate optical digital twins or test signal-based failure-management methods. It does not establish performance for every modulation format or network configuration; field transferability remains uncertain. The README contains some older archive names, so its logical descriptions should be reconciled with the current file inventory before reuse. No related catalogue or first-review record explicitly identifies this dataset or its alternate DOI. Documentation was read, but samples and archives were not downloaded.
